title: The Rabby Token Send

captures.note: dry: stopped at the confirm screen

_comment: Rabby sending an ERC-20 (0.5 mUSD), not ETH. Same Rabby backbone as R1; the tx's 'to' is the token contract with the recipient inside transfer() calldata. What the token adds: picking the token runs through Rabby's servers — token_search, then tapping mUSD opens a detail sheet fed by /v1/token/identity and /v1/token/price_curve, and you must press its Confirm to select the token. Recipient checks seen on this run: /v1/engine/addr/has_transfer, used_chain_list, is_spoofing (address-poisoning check). Real mainnet tx 0xf94d95699365ee5a597af944ccb8520b19cdbbdbed81cece067312a63007cd58.
